newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Communication registers to sell stock.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Communication registers to sell stock.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement on Form S-3 with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell Series A Telephony Group common stock.

The offering would be made following shareholder approval of two new series of Telephony Group target common stock at a special meeting of shareholders that is expected to occur in the first quarter of 1997.

The new target stock, to be designated as the Series A Telephony Group common stock and the Series B Telephony Group common stock, will reflect the separate performance of the Telephony Group of Tele-Communications.

The Telephony Group consists of TCI's partnership interests in its wireless telephony ventures known as Sprint PCS and TCI's equity interest in Teleport Communications Group Inc. Merrill Lynch & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co, Credit Suisse First Boston, and Salomon Brothers Inc will serve as underwriters.
